newsitem.title: UK: UK gives 70,000 stg to new aerospace company.
newsitem.headline: UK gives 70,000 stg to new aerospace company.

text.p: Britain has given 70,000 stg to a new company called United Avionics Ltd to break into the U.S. aerospace market, said the Department of Trade and Industry on Tuesday.
United Avionics is a new venture comprising five established British companies who already operate in the avionics sector of the UK aerospace industry.
The group has the backing of GEC-Marconi, owned by General Electric Co Plc, who will allow the company to be based at its facility in Atlanta, Georgia and will also provide marketing advice.
The company was formed as part of the DTI's Partnership Marketing Initiative.
